product.name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Joanna Contemporary Tufted Accent Chair with Reversible Cushions, 40"W, Blue
product.description: Clean lines give this armchair a modern, sophisticated look. Removable seat cushions and backs are comfortable and easy to adjust, and the performance fabric upholstery can be cleaned with a cloth or simple vacuuming. Steel seat springs and a wood frame provide structure, support and durability. Overall: 40"W x 37"D x 38"H. Seat height: 21.5"H; seat depth: 23"D; seat back height: 19"H Steel seat springs, wood frame and wood legs add structure and durability Loose, reversible seat cushions and inside back cushions in 100% polyester performance fabric Assemble in 15 minutes or less Lightly vacuum every month or two to remove dirt and dust Free returns for 30 days. 3-year warranty.
